name: fresh closed exactly 5 days old skips
spec_quote: A record that is FRESH (read_at at most 5 days before today, inclusive: read 5 days ago is fresh, 6 days ago is stale) and has status "closed" or "restricted" → the job is SKIPPED before any preparation work: its row gets the status "skipped: closed (prefetch YYYY-MM-DD)" or "skipped: restricted (prefetch YYYY-MM-DD)" with that read_at date, ready false.

name: fresh ok with needs shows prefetch_left
spec_quote: A fresh "ok" record → the job is prepared as before; its row additionally shows `prefetch_left` = the record's `needs` (a number; a missing `needs` shows nothing) so the report says how many questions are still open.
